title: Full-Body Strength & Conditioning
description: Forty-five full-body strength, conditioning, tendon, and shoulder-control intervals.

intervals.coachNote: March easily; the ramp is a cue rather than a tempo prescription, and the movement stays quiet.
Prepare the ankles with pumps and heel-to-toe rocks; calf raises come later.
Start shallow and deepen only as the heels remain down.
regressions: Use a smaller range or hold support if needed.

intervals.coachNote: Hinge from the hips with a long spine and reach without forcing range.
Switch actively through a comfortable range; do not force the right-hip end range.
regressions: Use hand support or a smaller range if the hip catches or pinches.

intervals.coachNote: Reach at the wall without shrugging or forcing the shoulder range.
Balance on the left and gently lift the arch without gripping the toes.
regressions: Use a wall or a toe tap for support; keep the foot quiet.

intervals.coachNote: Balance on the right and gently lift the arch without gripping the toes.
regressions: Use a wall or a toe tap for support; keep the foot quiet.

intervals.coachNote: Kick slowly with a controlled hold and return; keep the standing foot stable.
regressions: Use a wall for balance and lower the kick height.

intervals.coachNote: Use dumbbells if stable; keep the rear instep flat and breathe through the pause.
regressions: Keep the rear instep flat.

intervals.coachNote: Use a 1.5-rep push-up with a neutral shoulder and a controlled trunk.
regressions: Use knees-down or hands-elevated; fists do not unload the first MTP.

intervals.coachNote: Use dumbbells with a flat back and square pelvis.
regressions: Use wall support or a toe kickstand; keep the whole foot loaded.

intervals.coachNote: Use a clean hinge and pull with a quiet shoulder; reach RPE 8 without momentum.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or more support if the trunk rotates.

intervals.coachNote: Press with a neutral grip and stop before shoulder apprehension.

intervals.coachNote: Keep the pelvis level and avoid anterior-hip pinching.
regressions: Use a bilateral bridge or shorten the lever if pelvic control fades.

intervals.coachNote: Use a moderate stance width, hold the dumbbell at the chest, and breathe.
regressions: Use a lighter load or higher stance without forcing a lateral-hip stretch.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Use the prescribed cadence and keep the forefoot stable; never bounce.
regressions: Use support or less load; keep pain 0–3/10, below the 5/10 ceiling, and settled by next morning.

regressions: Use support or less load; keep pain 0–3/10, below the 5/10 ceiling, and settled by next morning.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Place a dumbbell on the thigh and load the soleus at 3 seconds up / 1 second hold / 3 seconds down.
regressions: Use less load or bilateral work within the same pain rules.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Place a dumbbell on the thigh and load the soleus at 3 seconds up / 1 second hold / 3 seconds down.
regressions: Use less load or bilateral work within the same pain rules.

intervals.coachNote: Use controlled knee lifts without bouncing; keep the feet quiet on the floor between lifts.
regressions: Reduce the knee height or use support while keeping the rhythm controlled.

intervals.coachNote: After the warm-up, hold one 7 kg dumbbell with both hands; drive from the hips with feet planted and no heel pop.
regressions: Use a lighter load or reduce the range; never jump the weight.

intervals.coachNote: Step and reach to the left with a flat, quiet landing; keep the range comfortable.
regressions: Use support or shorten the step; no hop.

intervals.coachNote: Step and reach to the right with a flat, quiet landing; keep the range comfortable.
regressions: Use support or shorten the step; no hop.

intervals.coachNote: Walk the hands out and back with the toe-safe knees-down option available.
regressions: Use knees-down or hands-elevated; fists do not unload the first MTP.

intervals.coachNote: Use combinations with both feet planted; do not bounce or chase technical failure.
regressions: Slow the combinations or reduce the range while keeping the feet planted.

intervals.coachNote: Walk briskly backward with whole-foot landings and a clear path.
regressions: Use a wall or rail for support and slow the pace.

intervals.coachNote: Carry two dumbbells with a tall trunk, steady steps, and relaxed shoulders.
regressions: Use lighter dumbbells or shorten the walking path.

intervals.coachNote: Press the inside knee into the wall for about 2 × 15 seconds with the pelvis level; this is a text cue, not a visual equivalence claim.
regressions: Reduce wall pressure or shorten the holds if lateral-hip pain appears.

intervals.coachNote: Raise slowly and lower for a deliberate eccentric; avoid leaning the trunk or provoking anterior pinching.

intervals.coachNote: Keep the elbow at the side and press the back of the hand into the wall for repeated short holds.
regressions: Use less pressure or shorter holds before shoulder apprehension.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 2 s hold / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Use support, keep the pelvis level, and control the whole arc.
regressions: Reduce the range or use more support if the pelvis tips.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 2 s hold / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Use support, keep the pelvis level, and control the whole arc.
regressions: Reduce the range or use more support if the pelvis tips.

intervals.coachNote: Use a gentle stretch with a posterior pelvic tilt; do not force the front of the hip.
regressions: Shorten the stance or raise the torso if the stretch becomes painful.
